what_it_does: Develops AskHPC, a large-language-model-based chatbot designed to help users of massive supercomputers find answers to technical questions. The system combines a curated knowledge base with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)—a technique that retrieves relevant documentation and feeds it to the language model—to provide accurate guidance across heterogeneous and complex HPC systems. Handles multimodal sources including code snippets, configuration guides, and best practices.
